speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) what are the circumstances under which the Silver Support payout quantum may be reduced for beneficiaries; and (b) whether there are ways by which changes may be better explained to reduce the anxiety and other negative consequences for the seniors who are unaware or do not expect the drop.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The letter and its accompanying infographic that explains the eligibility criteria are written in all four languages.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Those with registered Singpass mobile numbers will also receive an SMS notification.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: We appreciate that some seniors may still need help to understand changes to their payouts.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: They may visit the Silver Support website to check their eligibility status.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: I just wanted to ask the Minister of State this: many of our seniors who are eligible for the Silver Support Scheme are actually of a certain age, where they may not be literate, they may not understand an SMS that comes through the telephone, or they may not be able to appreciate the information provided by the Government.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Is there any way in which we can communicate to them in the language that they understand, the vernacular language?

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Or is there any way in which we can get the Community Clubs (CCs) or the grassroots leaders to convey and explain to them the reason for the reduction in the Silver Support Scheme?

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Otherwise, I can appreciate that for many of those who are less literate, it will be a big challenge to understand why it was this amount last year and this year, it will be reduced.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: Indeed, we recognise that some seniors may have difficulties understanding why there is a change in payout or why they are no longer eligible.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: We do have letters in the four vernacular languages to explain to the seniors and we also have a hotline which the seniors can call to make direct enquiries.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: I do agree with hon Member Mr Lim Biow Chuan that our grassroots leaders also can play an active role in helping to do the translation and helping them clarify on the reasons for the changes in payouts.
